cannibalizationSets.note: Calculator-intent and guide-intent pages are useful together, but titles and internal links should make the flagship calculator page the primary page for contribution-room calculator queries.
The 2026 withdrawal guide should be treated as the main withdrawal-rule explainer; older withdrawal/contribution-room content should point clearly into it.
This cluster has multiple comparison URLs. Keep the three-account comparison as the canonical decision page and use the account decision tool as the interactive next step.

Dividend and covered-call content is broad enough to support several pages, but each page should state its decision job clearly: ETF shortlist, tax mechanics, account location, or yield-risk education.
The CDR purchase guide should own practical access intent; the IPO, CDR explainer, hot-IPO risk, and TFSA-account-location pages should support different angles.
The cluster is small and clean: one tool, one budgeting article, one mechanics article.
